sources.entry: RedisClient - Redis client application on mac, windows and linux. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/UUGU/redis-client-app)

summary.one_liner: RCA (redis-client-app) is an Electron and Vue desktop application for connecting to and working with Redis, described as running on mac, windows and linux.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes RCA as a Redis client application for mac, windows and linux, built with Electron and Vue on Node.js. It is presented as a desktop app for interacting with Redis servers. The README does not list specific features such as key browsing, editing, or connection management. The project is in an early state, and the README says it has not been rigorously tested. The update log lists only an initial release in October 2017 and project init in August 2017.
use_cases: Browse a Redis server from a desktop app
Run a cross-platform Redis GUI on mac, windows or linux
Try an early open-source Redis client built with Electron
how_to_run: git clone the repository (the README's clone URL is truncated)
npm run make (packages the app; output goes to ./out)
notable: Cross-platform desktop Redis client built on Electron
Packaging through npm run make with output in ./out
Listed in awesome-mac under Databases and marked as freeware and open source
caveats: README warns the project has not been rigorously tested
Minimal documentation of features and the last update log entry is from 2017
License is not named in the README
